newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says produces six mln tonnes of steel a year.
newsitem.headline: Iran says produces six mln tonnes of steel a year.

text.p: Iran's current steel production has risen to six million tonnes a year from 1.2 million in 1989, Minister of Mines and Metals Mohammad Hossein Mahlouji said in remarks published on Monday.
Mahlouji, quoted by the daily Kar va Kargar newspaper, said Iran had also become an exporter of steel industry know-how, and referred to the country's participation in a steel project in Kuwait.

Construction of the Kuwait mill, which will produce 300,000 tonnes of steel bars a year using materials imported from Iran and other countries, will begin this year and take one to two years. -- Dubai newsroom +9714 6071 219
